feed.title: Unified AI System - self-hosted AI gateway and agent control plane
feed.subtitle: Every claim in these pages is reproducible: measured tool rosters, credential-free runs, and verbatim quotations from the projects compared.

entry.title: 23-attack security regression, run and logged: what a self-hosted AI gateway defends
entry.summary: All 23 attacks defended by the repository's own regression against a live local gateway: cross-tenant cache and audit isolation, header forgery, role checks, budget and rate enforcement, instant revocation, secret redaction, and metrics authorization. No credentials, one run.

entry.title: Unified AI System｜面向 Codex、Cursor、Cline 的开源 MCP AI 网关
entry.summary: 加固后的 Public Preview：面向 Codex、Cursor 和 Cline 的开源、自托管 MCP 与 AI 网关，提供无需 Provider 的提示增强与 12 个 MCP 工具。

entry.title: Unified AI System
entry.summary: Hardened Public Preview: an open-source, self-hosted MCP and AI gateway for Codex, Cursor, and Cline with provider-free prompt enhancement and reproducible verification.

entry.title: What a published MCP Docker image actually exposes: 9, 12, then 15 tools
entry.summary: We read the shipped source out of eight published Docker tags of our MCP server, verified every layer blob against its digest, and printed the tool roster each image really contains. No Docker daemon, no API key.

entry.title: 自托管 AI 网关对照：LiteLLM、Portkey、Agent Router 与 Unified AI System
entry.summary: 四个可自托管的 AI 网关，只用各项目自己 README 里的原文来描述：附链接、标注阅读日期，不替别人说它缺什么。

entry.title: Self-hosted AI gateways compared: LiteLLM, Portkey, Agent Router and Unified AI System
entry.summary: Four self-hostable AI gateways described in their own words: verbatim README lines, licenses and links, read on 2026-09-26, plus the three questions to ask any of them before handing over agent traffic.

entry.title: Credential-free AI gateway: how one run proves no provider was called
entry.summary: A usage-report envelope with mode=fake, providerCalled=false and credentialRequired=false, plus the enhanced prompt and preserved original request, from a 14-second local run.

entry.title: OpenAPI 转 MCP：把 REST API 变成受治理的 MCP 工具
entry.summary: 把任意 OpenAPI 3.0 或 3.1 文档生成为 MCP 工具，并置于显式允许清单之后：缺省即全部拒绝、只读声明、出站请求校验，以及审计边界。

entry.title: OpenAPI to MCP: turn a REST API into governed MCP tools
entry.summary: Convert any OpenAPI 3.0 or 3.1 spec into MCP tools behind an explicit allowlist: deny-by-default policy, read-only attestation, SSRF-checked outbound calls, and an audit boundary.

entry.title: Natural-Language Prompt Enhancement

entry.title: Run an MCP server in Codex with Docker
entry.summary: Connect Codex to a self-hosted MCP server with one Docker command, verify fifteen tools, enhance a prompt locally, and make a credential-free test call.

entry.title: Why an AI gateway should be terminal-first
entry.summary: A practical design case for terminal-first AI gateways: stable automation, explicit authority, observable execution, and an optional enterprise console.
